Plant cells, by comparison, offer intrinsic therapeutic potential and feature a bilayer structure composed of cell wall and cell membrane. Here, we utilize the carrot plant cells as oral colon-targeting drug delivery vehicles leveraging their intrinsic therapeutic properties and the outer layer of cell wall. Utilizing ulcerative colitis and glucocorticoid budesonide as a disease and drug model, the drug loading strategy, colon microenvironment sensitivity, colon-specific drug release and anti-inflammation efficacies of the plant cell-based delivery system are evaluated. In particular, the budesonide-loaded liposomes are linked to carrot cells via click chemistry to achieve budesonide-loaded carrot cells, which are validated to maintain stable and decrease the drug distribution and absorption in stomach and small intestine, while disintegrated by local microbiota after reaching colon to allow colon-targeting release. The glucocorticoid drug, intrinsic anti-inflammation substances in plant cells and the short-chain fatty acids generated by cell wall enzymatic degradation work synergistically to strengthen the therapeutic efficacy in ulcerative colitis mice models. This work provides insights into the development of plant-based drug excipients and offers an alternative strategy for the targeted treatment of colonic diseases.
papers.whyCare: A plant-cell-based oral delivery platform may offer reusable delivery or formulation principles, though the therapeutic application is distant from the lab.
papers.skepticism: Assess whether the plant-cell capsule provides a broadly useful strategy for protecting and delivering biological payloads.

lensReasons.main: 당근 세포를 경구 대장 표적 운반체로 활용해 궤양성 대장염 생쥐에서 약물과 식물 세포 성분의 항염 효과를 결합했습니다.
lensReasons.computational: 클릭 화학으로 budesonide 리포좀을 당근 세포에 연결하고 장내 미생물에 의한 분해를 이용해 대장 내 약물 방출을 평가했습니다.

papers.title: A deep-learning predictive model for Cas12a activity in wheat
papers.abstract: CRISPR technology has created targeted DNA mutations across the tree of life. Target sites are defined by RNA molecules that largely determine the efficiency of an experiment. Several predictive models are available to select the most efficient RNAs. Unfortunately, these models are not built with plant data and have limited predictive power in plant systems. To overcome this limitation, we established a high-throughput arrayed wheat protoplast transfection method and measured the editing efficiency of ~1,000 unique LbCas12a crRNAs at on- and off-target sites. We trained different models by testing 40 deep learning architectures and found that a convolutional neural network model called 2CaP-5 displayed the best performance. While 2CaP-5 had moderate to strong predictive power in protoplasts, it did not generalize to Agrobacterium-mediated transformation. Despite this limitation, we demonstrate that 2CaP-5 can be re-trained with as few as 500 crRNAs. The use of such a small training set is advantageous for low-throughput experimental systems such as typically found in transgenic plant systems. We also used ~2,000 off-targets in the wheat subgenomes to investigate Cas12a specificity. Our dataset confirms previous observations regarding off-targets, specifically that single mismatches reduce indel efficiency provided they are adjacent to the PAM and that off-target activity can be largely prevented by three mismatches. Altogether, our results show that the 2CaP-5 model has moderate to strong predictive power for Cas12a crRNAs in wheat protoplasts and will serve as a useful foundation for predictive tools in other plant species.
papers.shortSummary: 2CaP-5는 밀 protoplast에서 LbCas12a crRNA 활성을 예측하는 데 유용한 성능을 보였지만, Agrobacterium 매개 형질전환에는 일반화되지 않았다.
papers.whyCare: 식물 편집에서 기존 예측기의 성능이 제한적이라는 문제에 대해 밀 Cas12a 실측 데이터와 종·시스템 특화 모델링 출발점을 제공한다. 특히 protoplast에서 형질전환으로의 성능 전이 실패는 편집 예측에 전달 맥락을 포함해야 하는지 검증할 실질적 연구 질문이다.
papers.skepticism: 보고된 예측 성능이 어떤 독립 검증 분할과 정량 지표에 기반했는지 초록만으로는 확인할 수 없다. 또한 protoplast에서의 성능이 Agrobacterium 조건으로 전이되지 않았으므로, 전달 방식·세포 맥락 중 무엇이 성능 차이를 만드는지 분리해 검증해야 한다.

lensReasons.main: 밀 프로토플라스트에서 약 1,000개 Cas12a crRNA를 측정해 예측기를 학습했지만, 형질전환 조건으로 일반화되지 않았다. 편집기 설계와 관련되나 작물·Cas12a 특이성이 크다.
lensReasons.computational: 주요 산출물은 밀 Cas12a 활성 예측 모델이며, 실험 데이터로 학습했으나 다른 전달·세포 조건에서의 예측 성능은 제한적이다.

papers.title: Androgen stimulation rapidly reorganizes temporal 3D genome and epigenome states to trigger AR-mediated transcription in prostate cancer
papers.abstract: Androgen receptor (AR)-mediated transcription drives prostate cancer progression and remains a critical therapeutic target. AR activation by androgens triggers nuclear translocation, DNA binding at AR regulatory elements (AREs), and transcription initiation. This process involves co-factors such as FOXA1, epigenetic modifications, and three-dimensional (3D) chromatin interactions. However, the temporal coordination of these events during AR-mediated transcription remains poorly understood. Using a time-course androgen stimulation model in prostate cancer cells, we first integrated temporal multi-omics data within the MOFA+/MEFISTO framework, which identified three distinct temporal factors underlying AR-mediated transcriptional dynamics, and then used higher-resolution early time-course profiling to further explore the chromatin and transcriptional context of these temporal patterns. Our combined analyses revealed that rapid AR binding at gene promoters, as early as 5 min, is crucial for initiating nascent transcription of AR target genes. We found that H3K27 acetylation at flanking AREs, pre-marked by constitutive FOXA1 binding, occurs prior to AR recruitment. Additionally, androgen stimulation induced a temporal early shift in nascent transcription from MYC to AR target genes, associated with transient disruption of 3D chromatin interactions. Finally, we showed that CRISPR-mediated inhibition of AR-associated chromatin contacts suppresses distal linked target genes, demonstrating that dynamic genome architecture is functionally required for AR-driven transcription. Together these findings uncover the dynamic reorganization of 3D chromatin structure and transcription factor binding post-androgen stimulation, resulting in distinct temporal epigenomic states.
papers.shortSummary: 안드로겐 자극 뒤 AR 전사 활성화가 일어나는 시간 순서를 다중오믹스와 초기 시점 분석으로 추적했다. FOXA1이 미리 결합한 ARE 주변의 H3K27ac가 AR 모집보다 먼저 나타나고, AR은 5분 이내 표적 유전자 프로모터에 결합했다. 초기 nascent transcription은 일시적으로 MYC 표적에서 AR 표적으로 이동하며, 이 시기에 3D chromatin contact가 일시적으로 교란됐다.
papers.whyCare: 직접적인 편집기 엔지니어링 논문은 아니지만, genome editing 또는 다른 급성 perturbation 뒤 전사 변화와 chromatin 변화를 함께 시간 분해해 측정해야 한다는 점에서 랩의 후성유전학·유전자 조절 연구와 맞닿는다. 빠른 1차 반응과 뒤따르는 상태 변화를 구분하는 실험 논의에 적합하다.
papers.takeaway: 이 모델에서는 FOXA1에 의해 미리 준비된 조절영역의 H3K27ac가 AR 모집에 앞서고, 빠른 AR 결합과 초기 nascent transcription이 뒤따른다. 동시에 MYC에서 AR 표적으로의 일시적 전사 전환과 3D contact 변화가 관찰되며, contact 억제는 distal 표적 전사를 낮춘다.
papers.skepticism: 관찰된 distal 표적 유전자 억제가 3D contact 소실 자체 때문인지, CRISPR 개입이 국소 enhancer 접근성·활성도 함께 바꾼 결과인지는 핵심 구분점이다. 초록에는 contact 억제의 직접 측정과 국소 chromatin 대조군의 세부가 제시되지 않아, 이 인과 해석의 강도는 그 비교에 달려 있다.
papers.blurb: AR 자극의 시간적 epigenome 재편을 CRISPR 기능검증까지 연결해, 전사 조절의 인과성과 시간 분해 실험 설계에 유용한 논문입니다.

lensReasons.main: 시간경과 다중오믹스로 안드로겐 자극 뒤 AR 결합, 히스톤 표지, 3D 접촉의 순서를 밝히고 CRISPR 억제로 원거리 표적 유전자 조절을 검증했다. 인과적 염색질 연구지만 암 맥락에 한정된 적용성이다.
lensReasons.computational: MOFA+/MEFISTO를 다중오믹스 시간경과 데이터에 적용했으나, 계산 프레임워크 개발이 주된 기여는 아니다.

papers.title: Human cardiac organoids innervated by autonomic neurons using a mixoid approach model myocardial infarction under hypoxia
papers.abstract: Human pluripotent stem cell-derived organoids are powerful models of human development, disease, and drug discovery, but most lack innervation, limiting physiological relevance. We developed a simple, versatile method to generate innervated cardiac organoids, termed mixoids, by mixing neural and cardiomyocyte progenitors. Using human sympathetic and parasympathetic cardiac mixoids (hSCMs/hPCMs), we investigated autonomic regulation of human heart development. Sympathetic innervation was associated with functional coupling, improved cardiac architecture, enhanced transcriptional metabolic maturation, and shifted cellular composition toward an atrial cardiomyocyte (ACM) identity. Under hypoxia, hSCMs recapitulated myocardial infarction features including adrenergic overload, calcium mishandling, fibrosis, and apoptosis, which were reduced by the beta-blocker propranolol. Parasympathetic innervation similarly transcriptionally enhanced metabolic maturation and shifted the cardiomyocyte composition toward maturity and promoted an atrial-conduction system-associated identity. These findings establish cardiac mixoids as a platform to study autonomic regulation of heart development and disease and a potential strategy for generating other innervated organoids.
papers.whyCare: An engineered, innervated human organoid model for a defined disease and hypoxia context, aligned with the lab’s organoid and in vivo biology interests.
papers.skepticism: Assess the mixoid assembly strategy, organoid functional readouts, and whether its hypoxia model offers reusable design principles.

lensReasons.main: 신경 전구세포를 섞어 자율신경 지배 심장 오가노이드를 만들고 저산소 손상 및 프로프라놀롤 반응을 재현했다. 유용한 생리학적 모델이지만 오가노이드 분야 밖의 편집기 연구로 옮길 구체적 경로는 제한적이다.
lensReasons.computational: 전사체 분석은 세포 상태 변화를 뒷받침하는 수단이며 계산 방법론 자체가 주기여는 아니다.

papers.title: G3BP1-induced retrograde transport blockade triggers HSC activation and liver fibrosis via COPI alternative splicing
papers.abstract: The molecular mechanisms underlying hepatic stellate cell (HSC) activation and subsequent liver fibrogenesis remain incompletely elucidated. Here, Ras GTPase-activating protein-binding protein 1 (G3BP1) is identified a significant upregulation in liver specimens from patients with liver fibrosis and experimental murine fibrosis models. G3BP1 promotes HSC activation in human LX-2 cells, primary mouse HSCs, and CCl 4 -/BDL-induced fibrotic mouse models, acting independently of stress granules (SGs). Genetic ablation of hepatic G3BP1 attenuates HSC activation and fibrotic progression. Integrative transcriptomic and APEX‑mass spectrometry analyses in HSCs reveal that G3BP1 regulates alternative splicing of coat protein complex Ⅰ (COPI) subunits through functional interaction with the splicing factor heterogeneous nuclear ribonucleoprotein M (hnRNPM). The consequent accumulation of exon 2-deficient COPG1 and exon 8-deficient COPB2 isoforms impairs COPI-dependent retrograde transport and induces endoplasmic reticulum (ER) stress, which drives HSC activation and fibrogenesis. Further studies demonstrate that G3BP1 recruits SRPK1 to phosphorylate hnRNPM, thereby promotes alternative splicing of COPI subunits. Pharmacological intervention of G3BP1/SRPK1/hnRNPM improves liver fibrosis. In conclusion, these results uncover an unrecognized role of G3BP1 in HSC activation by promoting COPI alternative splicing, and provide a potential therapeutic target for liver fibrosis.
papers.whyCare: A causal trafficking and splicing mechanism connected to cell activation and fibrosis fits broad interest in organelle biology and molecular mechanisms.
papers.skepticism: May provide reusable concepts for studying intracellular transport perturbations and their downstream cellular consequences.

lensReasons.main: G3BP1이 hnRNPM과 SRPK1을 통해 COPI 유전자 스플라이싱과 역행 수송을 바꾸고 간성상세포 활성화 및 섬유화를 촉진함을 밝혔습니다.
lensReasons.computational: 전사체 분석과 APEX 질량분석으로 COPI 스플라이싱 경로를 규명하고, 세포·생쥐 모델에서 G3BP1 및 경로 억제 효과를 조사했습니다.

papers.title: scINTILLA: Single-Cell Integrated Inference, Labelling, and Landscape Analysis for Assessing the Quality and Hidden Diversity of Cell Annotations
papers.abstract: Single-cell RNA sequencing has made it possible to build atlases of millions of cells, but the cell-type labels in these atlases are rarely checked once they are assigned. When a label covers a transcriptionally heterogeneous population, every analysis that depends on it inherits the problem, and automated label transfer in particular becomes unreliable. We present scINTILLA (Single-Cell Integrated Inference, Labelling, and Landscape Analysis), a framework that scores every label in an annotated dataset from three complementary signals: clustering confusion (neighbours that share a cluster but carry another label), label fragmentation (one label spread over several clusters) and supervised consistency (agreement, confidence and entropy of a classifier ensemble). The three signals are combined into a per-label quality score, scINTILLA-F, which can optionally be rank-fused with the Silhouette width. To test whether the score finds real annotation problems, we injected three kinds of known errors (merged labels, contaminated labels and over-split labels) into five Human Cell Atlas datasets, giving 150 perturbed annotations, and compared scINTILLA with the Silhouette baseline, kNN purity, SCCAF and ROGUE in a pre-registered analysis. The four best of the eleven methods that score every label were all scINTILLA-based. The fusion of scINTILLA-F with Silhouette ranked first (balanced AUROC 0.908; Silhouette 0.896, kNN purity 0.815, SCCAF 0.770) and improved on the Silhouette baseline in every atlas, and adding fragmentation raised the detection of merged labels in every atlas. scINTILLA and the Silhouette baseline were complementary. The Silhouette baseline was better at finding merges, whereas scINTILLA was better at finding over-split labels. Applied to the real atlases, scINTILLA flagged the ``Unknown'' and monocyte-derived macrophage labels of the lung atlas and the ``stem cell'' label of the endoderm organoid atlas. Re-analysis of these populations resolved disease-associated monocyte and macrophage states and a set of progenitor, stromal and differentiated identities with distinct tissue and protocol origins. Finally, we tested the score on merges that arise naturally, in a leukaemia atlas of 183 patients whose blast populations we had annotated. Label fragmentation revealed the diversity of the blasts hidden under a patient label: in acute myeloid leukaemia it was higher in patients whose blasts formed several populations. In each of these cases scINTILLA pointed to the labels that needed a closer look, and the interpretation remained with the expert. It is therefore advisory: it ranks labels for expert review and shows which signal flagged each one.
papers.shortSummary: scINTILLA는 서로 다른 라벨 품질 신호를 결합해 검토가 필요한 세포 라벨을 우선순위화하며, Silhouette와 함께 쓰면 인위적으로 주입한 오류 탐지 성능이 개선된다고 주장한다.
papers.whyCare: Perturb-seq와 스크리닝 데이터에서는 라벨 오류가 세포 상태별 효과 해석을 왜곡할 수 있다. 이 방법은 재분석 우선순위를 라벨 단위로 정하는 보조 QC 후보이며, 편집기 자체나 생물학적 기전을 제시하는 연구는 아니다.
papers.skepticism: 인위적 오류 주입에서의 성능이 perturbation-driven 상태, 배치 차이, 희귀 전이 상태가 섞인 데이터에서도 유지되는지 불분명하다. 실제 atlas에서 표시된 라벨이 독립적인 전문가 adjudication이나 다른 정답 기준으로 확인되었는지도 초록에는 제시되지 않는다.

lensReasons.main: scINTILLA는 세포 주석의 혼합·오염·과분할을 찾고, 폐와 내배엽 오가노이드의 모호한 세포 라벨을 재분석해 숨겨진 세포 상태와 정체성을 드러냈다.
lensReasons.computational: scINTILLA는 군집 혼란, 라벨 분절, 분류기 일치도를 결합해 라벨별 품질을 점수화했으며, 다섯 Human Cell Atlas 자료의 인위적 오류 평가에서 Silhouette과 결합한 점수가 균형 AUROC 0.908을 기록했다.

papers.title: Nuclear factor I connects H3K27M to a targetable purine dependency in diffuse intrinsic pontine glioma
papers.abstract: Diffuse intrinsic pontine glioma is a lethal pediatric brainstem cancer with few effective treatments. Here, we integrate metabolomic, transcriptomic, chromatin, genetic and in vivo analyses to identify a purine-metabolic dependency associated with the H3K27M histone mutation. The histone H3 lysine 27-to-methionine substitution increases Nuclear Factor I transcriptional activity, which promotes coordinated expression of enzymes involved in purine biosynthesis and degradation, including 5-aminoimidazole-4-carboxamide ribonucleotide formyltransferase/inosine monophosphate cyclohydrolase and purine nucleoside phosphorylase. Sustained purine degradation limits feedback inhibition of purine synthesis, enabling continued purine production, utilization and catabolism. Genetic or pharmacological inhibition of the terminal de novo purine biosynthesis enzyme reduces tumor-cell fitness, slows orthotopic tumor progression and extends survival in mice. These results connect histone-mutation-associated chromatin remodeling to a Nuclear Factor I-regulated, therapeutically targetable purine dependency in diffuse intrinsic pontine glioma.
papers.whyCare: A potentially causal chromatin-to-metabolism mechanism with a targetable dependency; relevance beyond this tumor context is unclear from the title.
papers.skepticism: Could offer useful mechanistic insight into chromatin-state effects on cellular metabolism or assays for nucleotide dependencies.

lensReasons.main: H3K27M–NFI 연결이 퓨린 대사 의존성을 만들고, 유전·약리 억제가 정위 종양 진행과 생존에 영향을 준다. 강한 후성유전학·치료 기전이지만 연구실 핵심 편집기 프로그램과는 간접적이다.
lensReasons.computational: 다중오믹스 통합은 기전 연구를 뒷받침하지만 별도의 계산 방법론이 중심은 아니다.

papers.title: A leptin receptor–LRP1 complex in the choroid plexus and tanycytes mediates leptin entry into the mouse brain
papers.abstract: Obesity is characterized by central leptin resistance, in which elevated circulating leptin fails to reach or activate its hypothalamic targets. Yet the mechanisms that mediate leptin transport into the brain remain incompletely understood. Here, we show that in the choroid plexus (ChP), leptin promotes the physical coupling of the leptin receptor (LepR) and low-density lipoprotein receptor-related protein-1 (LRP1) to form a functional LRP1–LepR complex. Deletion of LepR or LRP1 in Foxj1-expressing cells, which include ChP epithelial cells and hypothalamic tanycytes, disrupts leptin entry into the brain, impairs hypothalamic leptin signaling, and induces hyperphagia and obesity. Intracerebroventricular leptin restores the anorexigenic response, confirming that the defect is in transport rather than central signaling. In diet-induced obese mice, formation of the LRP1–LepR complex is impaired, contributing to leptin resistance. These findings identify the LRP1–LepR complex in the ChP and tanycytes as an essential gateway for leptin entry into the brain and a potential therapeutic target in obesity.
papers.whyCare: The title describes a specific receptor complex mediating transport into the brain, potentially a causal mechanism of biological delivery across a tissue barrier.
papers.skepticism: Could inform delivery constraints and mechanisms for transport into the CNS; abstract will clarify how directly the mechanism is established.

lensReasons.main: 맥락얼기와 타니사이트의 LRP1–LepR 복합체가 혈중 렙틴의 뇌 유입을 매개하며, 비만 생쥐에서는 복합체 형성 저하가 렙틴 저항성과 연결된다.
lensReasons.computational: Foxj1 발현 세포에서 LepR 또는 LRP1을 조건부 제거하고 뇌실 내 렙틴 구제와 식이유발 비만 생쥐 분석을 수행해 수송 결함을 중추 신호 결함과 구분했다.

papers.title: SMC5/6 safeguards chromatin compartments and TAD boundaries for genome stability
papers.abstract: SMC5/6, a member of the Structural Maintenance of Chromosomes family, coordinates 3D genome organization, chromatin states, and transcriptional regulation, yet its role in higher-order chromatin architecture remains poorly defined. Here, we investigate the impact of conditional SMC5 depletion in human B lymphoblastoid cells. Hi-C analyses reveal global rewiring of chromatin interactions, with increased long-range and reduced short-range contacts, leading to altered large-scale chromosome organization. SMC5 loss induces changes in 3D genome compartmentalization affecting ~2% of the genome and is accompanied by transcriptional upregulation of inflammatory and cancer-associated gene programs. SMC5 depletion also promotes double-strand break accumulation, preferentially in active compartments and following gene expression levels. However, regions undergoing architectural reorganization display comparatively fewer breaks, indicating that chromatin changes are not driven by DNA damage. Together, our findings establish SMC5/6 as a key regulator of chromatin compartmentalization and TAD boundary integrity, linking 3D genome organization to transcriptional control and genome stability.
papers.whyCare: Mechanistic study connecting chromatin architecture to genome stability, directly relevant to epigenetics and genome biology.
papers.skepticism: May inform how chromatin organization and genome maintenance affect editing outcomes or cell-state stability.

lensReasons.main: SMC5 고갈과 Hi-C 분석으로 염색질 구획·TAD 경계 변화 및 DNA 손상과의 관계를 제시한 인과적 크로마틴 연구다. 편집기 설계로의 직접 연결은 약하다.
lensReasons.computational: Hi-C 분석은 3차원 유전체 구조 변화를 측정하는 데 쓰였으며, 계산 방법 개발이 중심은 아니다.

papers.title: A noncanonical reducing-domain architecture defines a distinct class of modular polyketide synthases
papers.abstract: Colibactin is a microbiome-derived genotoxin that damages the genomes of intestinal epithelial cells and has been linked to colorectal cancer. Its biosynthesis is encoded by a large gene cluster ( pks / clb ) that functions as a hybrid nonribosomal peptide synthetase - polyketide synthase assembly line, yet the structural basis of its assembly remains poorly understood. Here we show cryo-electron microscopy structures of colibactin biosynthetic enzyme ClbB that uncover a noncanonical architecture for a fully-reducing polyketide synthase module. Unlike metazoan fatty acid synthases and iterative polyketide synthases, ClbB arranges its condensing and reducing regions in a crossed configuration. Within its reducing region, the enoylreductase forms an inverted dimer and the dehydratase is positioned peripherally as monomers. Moreover, the dehydratase-enoylreductase unit is embedded within the ketoreductase fold. Bioinformatic analyses combined with deep-learning-based structure prediction indicate that this domain-embedding logic is broadly distributed across diverse bacterial phyla. These findings define a structurally distinct class of reducing polyketide synthase modules and provide an expanded structural framework for understanding how modular polyketide synthases coordinate multi-step chemistry. The work also extends design principles for engineering megasynthases for chemical biosynthesis and synthetic biology.
papers.whyCare: A distinct enzyme architecture may offer protein-organization or structure-function insights, but the title gives no direct lab connection.
papers.skepticism: Check whether the work establishes transferable principles for modular enzyme architecture or engineering.

lensReasons.main: ClbB의 cryo-EM 구조가 폴리케타이드 합성효소에서 예상 밖의 도메인 배치와 환원 영역 구조를 드러낸다. 거대 효소 조립체의 설계 원리를 넓히지만, 직접 전용은 특정 생합성 시스템에 한정된다.
lensReasons.computational: 구조 예측과 생물정보 분석은 구조의 분포를 보완하며, 계산 방법 자체가 주된 기여는 아니다.

papers.title: SMYD1 trimethylates myosin K129 to restrain cardiomyocyte hypercontractility
papers.abstract: Mutations in the force-generating motor protein myosin are common etiologic drivers of hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCM), a prevalent inherited cardiac disease. However, whether deregulation of myosin post-translational modifications also contributes to HCM remains unknown. Here we show that SMYD1 selectively catalyzes trimethylation of cardiac β-myosin heavy chain at lysine 129 (MyHC-K129me3), and that loss of this activity promotes cardiomyocyte hypercontractility and is linked to HCM pathogenesis. A biochemical-proteomic coupled strategy identifies MyHC-K129 as the principal physiological substrate of SMYD1 in human iPSC-derived cardiomyocytes (iPSC-CMs). The SMYD1-MyHC co-crystal structure reveals extensive interactions underlie K129 substrate specificity and shows that the HCM-associated SMYD1 F272L mutation disrupts S -adenosyl-L-methionine binding, thereby compromising catalytic activity. K129me3 loss alters the myosin motor domain intrinsic mechanical behavior, decreasing maximal ATP turnover rate and motility. Finally, eliminating K129 methylation enhances contractility and force generation in iPSC-CM monolayers and engineered cardiac tissues. Collectively, our results uncover a pivotal role for the SMYD1-MyHC-K129me3 axis in restraining cardiac contractility, providing insight into the pathogenic mechanism of an HCM-associated SMYD1 mutation.
papers.whyCare: A defined protein-modification mechanism in cardiac cells, but no clear link to the lab’s major directions.
papers.skepticism: May provide a reusable cellular mechanism or assay if the work has broader implications for protein function or cell-state control.

lensReasons.main: SMYD1의 MyHC K129 삼중메틸화가 미오신의 운동 특성을 조절해 심근세포의 과수축과 힘 생성을 억제하며, 비대성 심근병증 연관 변이의 기전을 설명한다.
lensReasons.computational: 생화학·단백질체 분석과 SMYD1–MyHC 공결정 구조, iPSC 유래 심근세포 및 공학적 심장 조직을 결합해 기질 특이성과 변이 효과를 분석했다.

papers.title: HER2 µMap proximity labeling reveals functional interactors and resistance mechanisms
papers.abstract: Interactions among receptor tyrosine kinases (RTKs), particularly HER2, drive the growth of subsets of breast cancer, yet the mechanisms of HER2 dependency and resistance to targeted therapies remain unclear. Here, using high-resolution photocatalytic microenvironment mapping (µMap) proximity labeling, we defined the HER2 interactome across a panel of human breast cancer models. We identified protein tyrosine phosphatase F as a broadly upregulated, pan-cancer HER2 interactor whose depletion suppresses proliferation even in HER2-low contexts. Temporal µMap profiling of trastuzumab internalization revealed WWP2 as the E3 ubiquitin ligase responsible for HER2 degradation. In trastuzumab-resistant models, galectin family proteins were selectively enriched, and genetic or pharmacologic galectin inhibition restored drug sensitivity. Galectin blockade destabilized HER2 and other RTKs and enhanced antibody-mediated receptor degradation. These findings provide an extensive HER2 interactomic resource and demonstrate the utility of µMap proximity labeling for charting oncogenic protein networks and uncovering actionable vulnerabilities in breast cancer.
papers.whyCare: A proximity-labeling approach paired with functional analysis could be a reusable assay, despite the cancer-specific application.
papers.skepticism: Assess whether µMap offers adaptable interaction mapping or screening logic relevant to protein engineering or cell biology.

lensReasons.main: HER2 근접 표지로 상호작용체를 지도화하고 WWP2 및 갈렉틴 억제가 수용체 분해와 약물 민감성에 미치는 영향을 보였다. 기능적 상호작용 발굴법은 참고할 만하지만 유방암 치료 저항성에 특화되어 있다.
lensReasons.computational: 근접 표지와 기능 교란 실험이 주된 접근이며 계산·AI 기여는 제한적이다.

papers.title: De novo identification of protein domains in cryo-electron tomography maps from AlphaFold2 models
papers.abstract: Sub-tomogram averaging of cryo-electron tomography maps often fails to reach the resolution required for atomic model building based on side-chain information, preventing accurate protein identification from the density alone. We develop DomainSeeker, which identifies protein domains by integrating AlphaFold2 models with experimental data. It partitions these models into domains by clique analysis of predicted aligned errors, fits them into segmented densities, and evaluates each fit globally and locally, deriving prior probabilities. Bayesian inference integrates the priors with cross-linking mass spectrometry, computing posterior probabilities. Applying prior probability analysis to mouse sperm microtubule doublet densities reveals higher recognition accuracy and resolution robustness than existing approaches. Incorporating cross-linking mass spectrometry for yeast nuclear pore complex densities further improves recognition performance and confidence. An interactive ChimeraX plugin facilitates user access. In this work, DomainSeeker addresses a bottleneck in in situ structural biology and supports visual proteomics in native cellular environments.
papers.whyCare: A computational method linking predicted structures to cryo-ET maps could enable structural interpretation of cellular assemblies.
papers.skepticism: Potentially reusable for structural biology of editors, delivery systems, or organelles; abstract needed to assess performance and scope.

lensReasons.main: DomainSeeker는 AlphaFold2 구조와 cryo-전자단층촬영 밀도, 교차결합 질량분석을 통합해 저해상도 세포 내 밀도에서 단백질 도메인을 더 정확하고 안정적으로 식별한다.
lensReasons.computational: 예측 정렬오차 기반 clique 분석으로 모델을 도메인별로 나누고 밀도에 맞춘 뒤, 적합도 사전확률과 교차결합 자료를 베이지안 추론으로 통합한다.

papers.title: A neuroimmune dichotomy for T cell immunity in the mesenteric iymph node in mice
papers.abstract: Peripheral nerves innervate lymphoid organs, yet how they decode immune signals and direct adaptive immunity remains unknown. Here we show, using three-dimensional tissue imaging, in vivo calcium recordings, single-cell transcriptomics, and chemogenetics in mice, that the mesenteric lymph node (mLN) harbours functionally antagonistic neural circuits that govern T cell fate. Vagal sensory neurons selectively detect IL-1β and TNF-α and release calcitonin gene-related peptide (CGRP), which suppresses Foxp3⁺ regulatory T (T reg ) cells and expands cytotoxic CD8⁺ effector T (T eff ) cells. Conversely, sympathetic neurons sense IL-6 and release norepinephrine (NE), promoting T reg accumulation while restraining effector responses. During Citrobacter rodentium infection, the sympathetic–NE–T reg axis is protective, whereas the vagal–CGRP axis drives immunopathology. T reg -specific deletion of the CGRP receptor or the β₂-adrenergic receptor confirms that these opposing signals converge on T reg cells to calibrate mucosal host defence. These findings establish the mLN as an autonomic rheostat for intestinal immunity.
papers.whyCare: Potentially mechanistic neuroimmune biology, but the title provides no clear link to the lab’s core directions.
papers.skepticism: Abstract may reveal a broadly useful immune-cell perturbation, signaling mechanism, or in vivo assay.

lensReasons.main: 장간막 림프절에서 미주신경-CGRP는 조절 T세포를 줄이고 CD8 효과 T세포를 늘리는 반면, 교감신경-노르에피네프린은 반대 방향으로 작용해 장 감염의 방어와 병리를 조절한다.
lensReasons.computational: 생쥐에서 3차원 조직 영상, 생체 내 칼슘 기록, 단일세포 전사체 분석과 화학유전학적 조작을 결합해 신경 회로와 T세포 반응을 조사했다.

papers.title: Large-scale quantitative assessment of tissue preparation and staining conditions for robust multiplexed imaging of FFPE tissue samples
papers.abstract: Multiplexed protein imaging or spatial proteomics enables the simultaneous measurement of over 50 proteins in intact tissues at single-cell resolution, providing insights into tissue organization and cellular interactions. However, variation in tissue preparation and staining protocols remains a major source of technical variability, limiting reproducibility and comparability across studies and platforms. Here we present a large-scale, multisite and multi-platform benchmarking study of tissue preparation conditions for formalin-fixed paraffin-embedded (FFPE) tissues. We systematically evaluated 24 combinations of antigen retrieval and antibody staining conditions using a 27-marker immune panel and ranked performance using quantitative metrics that capture signal intensity, variability and marker failure. Tris–EDTA-based antigen retrieval combined with overnight antibody staining at 4 °C consistently achieved the highest performance, whereas several commonly used alternatives showed reduced robustness. Validation across additional academic and industry laboratories and multiple imaging technologies confirmed the generalizability of these findings across tissues and platforms. We further show that marker signal intensity correlated with greater spatial heterogeneity, improving the detection of diverse cell populations. Together, our results provide practical guidelines and a standardized benchmarking strategy to improve reproducibility, harmonize workflows and facilitate cross-study comparisons in spatial proteomics.
papers.whyCare: Systematic imaging optimization may offer reusable assay or benchmarking logic, though the focus on FFPE tissue is not an obvious lab fit.
papers.skepticism: Potentially useful quantitative design and validation principles for multiplexed imaging assays.

lensReasons.main: 다기관·다플랫폼 비교로 FFPE 공간 단백질 이미징의 재현성 높은 항원 회수 및 염색 조건을 제시했다. 실무적 표준화 가치가 크지만 연구실의 핵심 편집기·미토콘드리아 프로그램과는 거리가 있다.
lensReasons.computational: 정량 성능 지표를 이용한 프로토콜 벤치마킹이며, 계산 분석이 주된 과학적 기여는 아니다.

papers.title: Super-resolution microscopy reveals distinct epigenetic states regulated by estrogen receptor activity
papers.abstract: Changes in gene expression regulated by ligand-dependent transcription factors including estrogen receptor-α (ERα) involve coactivator recruitment and H3K27ac deposition. While H3K27ac marks active enhancers, the chromatin architecture of enhancers remains unclear. Using super-resolution microscopy, we reveal distinct H3K27ac-modified chromatin structures in response to ERα activation. Estradiol (E2) treatment promotes elongated H3K27ac structures, whereas ERα inhibition induces compact, spherical conformations. Larger H3K27ac structures show greater MED1 association than compact structures, indicating distinct spatial relationships with enhancer-associated transcriptional machinery. Spatial analyses revealed that estrogen signaling reorganizes H3K27ac into densely packed nanoscale territories enriched for larger domains. Complementary genomic and transcriptomic analyses showed that broader H3K27ac regulatory regions are associated with MED1 occupancy and increased transcriptional output. The endocrine therapy-resistant ERα Y537S mutation maintains elongated chromatin states independent of ligand. These findings uncover the -spatial dimension of H3K27ac chromatin organization in ERα-responsive and endocrine-resistant breast cancer.
papers.whyCare: Combines an enabling imaging approach with a mechanistic link between transcription-factor activity and epigenetic states.
papers.skepticism: Potentially useful imaging and analysis concepts for studying chromatin-state changes and perturbation effects.

lensReasons.main: 초고해상도 현미경으로 에스트로겐 신호에 따른 H3K27ac 염색질 구조 변화를 관찰하고, 내분비 치료 저항성 ERα 변이에서 길쭉한 구조가 유지됨을 보였습니다.
lensReasons.computational: 유전체·전사체 분석에서 넓은 H3K27ac 조절 영역이 MED1 결합 및 높은 전사량과 연관됨을 확인했습니다.

papers.title: A measurement noise scaling law for cellular representation learning
papers.abstract: Abstract Large genomic and imaging datasets can be used to train models that learn meaningful representations of cellular systems. Across domains, model performance improves predictably with dataset size and compute budget, providing a basis for allocating data and computation. Scientific data, however, are also limited by noise arising from factors such as molecular undersampling, sequencing errors and image resolution. Here we introduce mutual information with auxiliary signals as a metric of representation model performance and study its scaling with noise. By fitting more than 2,000 representation learning models across three data modalities (gene expression, sequence and image data), we show that noise defines a distinct axis along which performance improves. Noise scaling follows a logarithmic law. We derive the law from a model of noise propagation, and use it to define noise sensitivity and model capacity as benchmarking metrics. We show that protein-sequence representations tolerate error rates in modern sequencing data, whereas single-cell transcriptomic models remain noise limited at current measurement signal-to-noise ratio levels. Within transcriptomic cell-state representation learning models, we find that transformer-based models are more noise robust but less performant than variational autoencoders. Noise scaling metrics may support future model evaluation and experimental design.
papers.shortSummary: 측정 노이즈에 따른 표현학습 성능 변화를 로그 스케일 법칙으로 설명할 수 있고, 이를 노이즈 민감도와 모델 용량의 벤치마크로 삼을 수 있다는 주장이다.
papers.whyCare: Perturb-seq 등에서 데이터 규모만 늘리는 대신, 측정 노이즈가 실제 모델 성능의 병목인지 분리해 볼 관점을 제공한다. 다만 초록만으로는 실험실의 측정 조건에 적용할 수치적 깊이 기준까지 얻을 수 없다.
papers.skepticism: 보조 신호와의 mutual information이 생물학적으로 유용한 상태 표현을 대변하는지, 노이즈가 실제 측정 변동을 잘 모사하는지 확인해야 한다. 초록에는 노이즈 구간별 효과 크기, 데이터 분할·배치 통제, 모델·코드 재현성 정보가 없어 보편적인 측정 깊이 처방으로 해석하기 어렵다.

lensReasons.main: 세 데이터 유형에서 2,000개가 넘는 표현 학습 모델을 분석해 측정 잡음에 따른 성능 저하가 로그 법칙을 따르며, 현재 신호대잡음비에서는 단일세포 전사체 표현 학습이 잡음에 제한됨을 보였다.
lensReasons.computational: 보조 신호를 활용한 상호정보량으로 모델 성능을 측정하고 잡음 스케일링 법칙을 적합해 민감도와 용량 지표를 제안했으며, 전사체에서는 transformer가 VAE보다 잡음에 강하지만 성능은 낮다고 비교했다.

papers.title: Learning interpretable rules of protein binding from a trillion interactions
papers.abstract: Protein binders are invaluable as research tools and therapeutics, yet why some targets readily yield binders while others resist discovery remains poorly understood. Here we quantify this variability through more than 1,300 independent selections against 96 protein targets, experimentally surveying over one trillion protein-protein interactions. We find that binder density-the probability that a random protein variant binds a target is reproducible, varies by at least five orders of magnitude, and depends primarily on target identity rather than library design. To uncover the molecular determinants of binding, we develop an energy-based machine-learning model that learns pairwise interactions between target and binder residues from protein language model embeddings, and introduce a decomposition that resolves these interactions into interpretable feature-feature couplings. Strikingly, the features associated with binders are extensively shared across targets, whereas those associated with targets are largely unique. These features both recover established molecular recognition mechanisms and identify previously unrecognized interactions in natural proteins. Several of the newly predicted interactions are validated experimentally. Our findings establish a quantitative framework for binder discovery and reveal a shared, interpretable, and transferable molecular vocabulary for predicting protein-protein interactions.
papers.shortSummary: binder 발굴 난이도는 표적에 따라 크게 달라지며, binder에는 여러 표적에 공유되는 결합 특징이 있지만 표적 쪽 특징은 주로 표적 고유하다는 주장이다.
papers.whyCare: 라이브러리 설계만으로 hit 수율을 설명하기보다 표적 자체의 binder density와 표적별 상호작용 특징을 고려해야 한다는 정량적 관점을 제공한다. 이는 binder 발굴의 표적 선정·결과 해석에는 유용할 수 있지만, 현재 PI의 핵심 엔지니어링 문제와의 연결은 간접적이다.
papers.skepticism: 대규모 상호작용 조사와 일부 실험 검증은 강점이다. 다만 초록만으로는 표적·선별 단위의 train/test 분리, 음성대조, 표적 패널 선정 기준, 모델 및 데이터 공개 여부를 알 수 없어 전이성과 재현성을 판단하기 어렵다.

lensReasons.main: 96개 표적에 대한 대규모 선택 실험에서 결합체 생성 가능성이 표적에 따라 크게 달라짐을 보이고, 표적별 특성과 여러 표적에 공유되는 결합 규칙을 밝혀 결합체 탐색의 틀을 제시한다.
lensReasons.computational: 단백질 언어모델 임베딩으로 표적과 결합체 잔기 사이의 쌍별 상호작용을 학습하는 에너지 기반 모델을 만들고, 특성 결합으로 분해해 예측 상호작용 일부를 실험 검증했다.

papers.title: Hepatokine AGP2 mediates physical exercise-induced bone augmentation through liver-bone signaling communication
papers.abstract: Physical exercise promotes bone health. However, its underlying mechanisms remain incompletely elucidated. Here, we identified the hepatokine AGP2 as an osteoanabolic mediator of exercise. Exercise increases circulating AGP2 levels in mice and humans. Hepatocyte-specific Agp2 knockout substantially attenuates exercise-induced bone formation, whereas hepatic AGP2 overexpression prevents bone loss in ovariectomized mice. Mechanistically, exercise-induced lactate promotes hepatic Agp2 expression through histone H3K14 lactylation. Secreted AGP2 directly binds the Wnt co-receptor LRP5, activates Wnt/β-catenin signaling, promotes osteoblast differentiation, and suppresses osteoclast activity. Recombinant AGP2 administration also alleviates bone loss in mouse models of osteoporosis. Thus, these findings delineate a critical role of liver-bone crosstalk in mediating the beneficial effects of exercise on bone metabolism, highlighting AGP2 as a key mediator in exercise-induced bone anabolism and suggesting AGP2 as a potential therapeutic target for the treatment of metabolic bone disorders.
papers.whyCare: A causal inter-organ signaling mechanism, though its exercise and bone physiology focus has no obvious direct lab connection.
papers.skepticism: Could offer a useful example of mechanistic inter-organ signaling or a transferable in vivo study design.

lensReasons.main: 운동으로 생성된 젖산이 간의 H3K14 젖산화를 통해 AGP2를 유도하고, AGP2가 LRP5–Wnt/β-catenin 신호를 활성화해 뼈 형성을 촉진하는 간-뼈 축을 제시한다.
lensReasons.computational: 간세포 특이적 Agp2 결손 및 간 과발현 생쥐와 재조합 AGP2 처치, LRP5 결합 분석을 통해 운동과 뼈 형성을 잇는 기전을 조사했다.

papers.title: Transcriptional nodes governing diversity and effector rewiring of a plastic liver invariant natural killer T cell ecosystem
papers.abstract: Invariant natural killer T (iNKT) cells are thought to exit the thymus as terminally differentiated subsets that seed tissues with fixed effector biases. However, the composition, regulatory architecture and plasticity of tissue-resident iNKT cell compartments remain ill-defined. Here, we chart the cellular diversity and transcription-factor (TF) circuitry of mouse liver-resident iNKT (LiNKT) cells and delineate intrahepatic differentiation at steady state and following repeated intravascular αGalCer/CD1d stimulation. Single-cell profiling identifies eight subsets with distinct transcriptional signatures—LiNKT2 (IL-4/IL-13-biased), LiNKT17 (IL-17A-biased), LiNKTR1 (TR1-like, IL-10-biased), and five NKT1-like (IFNγ-biased) states including LiNKT1.1, LiNKT1.2, LiNKT1.3, Klrg1 low Cx3cr1 low Effector and Klrg1 high Cx3cr1 high Effector populations. Trajectory and compositional analyses reveal that iterative stimulation expands LiNKT2 and drives their conversion into LiNKTR1, while LiNKT1.1 seeds Effector and Klrg1⁺Cx3cr1⁺ Effector states, revealing local specification layered atop thymic priming. Conditional deletion across seven signature TFs associated with each subset maps subset dependencies and fate transitions: BCL-6 and TCF-1 sustain global iNKT output and, together with T-BET, license all NKT1-like states. BCL-6, ID3, and IRF4 drive Effector LiNKT1; BCL-6 and c-MAF specify LiNKT17; BLIMP-1 promotes LiNKT2 and, with c-MAF and IRF4, enforces LiNKTR1 specification. BLIMP-1 and ID3 oppose each other in LiNKTR1 versus Effector LiNKT1 differentiation. Thus, the hepatic iNKT compartment emerges as a TF-wired, plastic network in which local cues and subset-specific TF combinations govern lineage progression, nominating actionable nodes for tuning liver inflammation and repair.
papers.whyCare: May provide a causal account of transcriptional regulation and cell-state plasticity, but the immune-cell focus offers no obvious direct lab bridge.
papers.skepticism: Could inform thinking about transcriptional control of cell-state transitions or reusable perturbation approaches.

lensReasons.main: 단일세포 분석과 TF 조건부 결손으로 간 iNKT의 가소성과 분화 회로를 밝힌다. 간 염증 조절에는 의미 있지만 편집기·전달·미토콘드리아 엔지니어링과의 직접 연결은 약하다.
lensReasons.computational: 단일세포 전사체와 궤적 분석은 기전 규명에 쓰이며, 계산 방법 자체가 주된 기여는 아니다.

papers.title: Wnk1 drives CD4+ T cell lineage fate determination and bone marrow homing in a mouse model of retinal autoimmune disease
papers.abstract: Dysfunctional CD4 + T helper (Th) cell differentiation and migration, along with bone marrow (BM) myeloid hematopoietic responses, contribute to the progression of inflammatory and autoimmune diseases, yet the regulatory mechanisms remain unclear. Here, we perform single-cell transcriptomics of BM, cervical draining lymph nodes, and retinas in a mouse model of experimental autoimmune uveitis to comprehensively profile T-cell immune dynamics. We find that Wnk1 upregulation promotes expansion, differentiation, and migration of pro-inflammatory Th1 and Th17 cells by activating the c-Myc/glycolysis pathway. Genetic or pharmacological inhibition of Wnk1 reduces ocular inflammation, T-cell chemotaxis, and trafficking to BM and retina, accompanied by reduced BM-derived neutrophils and monocytes and fewer myeloid cells in draining lymph nodes and retina. In Vogt-Koyanagi-Harada patients, Wnk1 is elevated in CD4 + T cells, and its inhibition impairs their proliferation and effector functions. Collectively, our data implicate Wnk1 as a key regulator of CD4 + T-cell behavior and inter-organ immune communication.
papers.whyCare: The title suggests a causal cell-fate and trafficking mechanism, but the immune-disease context is not a clear lab priority.
papers.skepticism: Could provide a useful example of signaling control over cell fate and in vivo trafficking.

lensReasons.main: 포도막염 생쥐 모델에서 Wnk1이 c-Myc와 해당작용을 통해 염증성 CD4+ T세포의 분화와 이동을 촉진함을 보였습니다.
lensReasons.computational: 골수·배액 림프절·망막의 단일세포 전사체를 분석해 T세포 면역 상태와 조직 간 이동을 추적했습니다.

papers.title: Distinct mechanisms of CNV formation at the human 15q13.3 locus
papers.abstract: Human chromosome 15q13.3 is a hotspot for recurrent pathogenic copy number variants (CNVs) associated with schizophrenia, developmental delay and epilepsy. We generated long-read genome assemblies for 10 patient-parent trios and compared them to 581 population control haplotypes from diverse ancestry where this complex region is fully resolved. We find that both the long (“BP4-BP5”) and short (“ CHRNA7 ”) forms of 15q13.3 CNVs arise predominantly by non-allelic homologous recombination (NAHR) whose susceptibility has been promoted by large inversion polymorphisms. While three BP4-BP5 breakpoints cluster in a 2 kbp PRDM9-enriched recombination hotspot, most CNVs are structurally distinct and affect the disease-relevant genes ARHGAP11B and CHRFAM7A differentially. Population analyses reveal at least 18 distinct structural haplotypes in 15q13.3 and show that the risk for BP4-BP5 CNVs is stratified more than 10-fold depending on ancestry, with 68.4% of Europeans but only 5.1% of East Asians predisposed, establishing inversion polymorphisms as major determinants of population-specific recurrent CNV susceptibility. Comparison to six ape species indicates that the duplication architecture promoting instability expanded recently and is largely human-specific.
papers.whyCare: Mechanistic study of human genome structural variation could inform understanding of genome rearrangement and editing-associated outcomes.
papers.skepticism: Potentially useful for discussing mechanisms of DNA rearrangement, repair, or structural-variant formation.

lensReasons.main: 15q13.3의 장·단형 CNV는 역위 다형성이 촉진한 비대립 상동재조합으로 주로 형성되며, 조상집단별 역위 소인 차이에 따라 BP4–BP5 CNV 위험이 10배 넘게 달라진다.
lensReasons.computational: 환자-부모 10개 삼인조의 장거리 판독 기반 유전체 조립을 581개 집단 대조 haplotype 및 유인원 비교와 결합해 CNV 절단점과 구조 haplotype을 분석했다.

papers.title: Structural basis for constitutive activation of oncogenic gp130 mutants found in human inflammatory hepatocellular adenomas
papers.abstract: Inflammatory hepatocellular adenomas (IHCAs) are benign liver tumors primarily driven by somatic mutations in the gp130 receptor, resulting in its constitutive activation. To uncover the structural mechanisms underlying this activation, we employ cryo-electron microscopy and mutagenesis to study five representative IHCAs-associated gp130 mutants and two engineered mutants with ligand-independent activity. Most mutants form “X”-shaped dimers through a 3D domain-swapping mechanism, characterized by large separations between juxtamembrane domains and reliant on D1 domain-mediated “tip-to-tip” interactions for dimer clustering and activation. A rare mutant displays a distinct “Y”-shaped dimer conformation, with closely aligned juxtamembrane domains enabling direct activation independent of dimer clustering. These findings highlight the diversity of gp130 mutant activation mechanisms and provide a foundation for developing therapeutic strategies targeting aberrant gp130 signaling in IHCAs.
papers.whyCare: A structural mechanism for receptor activation by disease-associated mutants could offer useful molecular insight, though the specific pathway is peripheral.
papers.skepticism: Structural and mechanistic principles may be relevant to interpreting protein function or designing perturbations.

lensReasons.main: 냉동전자현미경과 돌연변이 분석으로 gp130 종양 변이의 X형 및 Y형 이합체 구조와 서로 다른 활성화 방식을 밝혔습니다.
lensReasons.computational: 대표 gp130 변이와 인공 변이의 구조를 냉동전자현미경으로 분석하고 돌연변이 실험으로 이합체 형상과 활성화 기전을 조사했습니다.

papers.title: CD33-CD45 interaction in Alzheimer’s disease susceptibility
papers.abstract: CD 33 is associated with Alzheimer’s disease (AD) susceptibility. The AD-associated rs3865444 C risk variant reduces splicing of the sialic acid-binding domain, increasing the sialic acid-binding isoform seven-fold. Here we identify CD45, a GWAS-associated AD risk gene, as an immune cell-specific sialic acid-dependent cis CD33 binding partner, whose phosphatase activity CD33 inhibits. CD33 loss improved microglial amyloid beta clearance and protected against amyloid beta-induced dendritic spine loss in microglial-neuronal co-cultures, whereas CD45 loss impaired clearance, aligning with detrimental effects of CD33-mediated CD45 inhibition. CD33-CD45 interaction frequency was increased in monocytes from rs3865444 CC individuals versus rs3865444 AA , as well as in AD versus controls, independent of genotype. An interaction between CD33 and PTPRC (CD45) expression in human brain tissue was associated with a pathological AD diagnosis and global burden of AD pathology, consistent with the cellular findings above. Together, our results link CD33-mediated suppression of CD45 with AD genetic susceptibility and systemic myeloid dysfunction.
papers.whyCare: A specific receptor interaction may provide a molecular mechanism for neuroimmune disease susceptibility, but the title does not establish causal or reusable biology.
papers.skepticism: Could offer a relevant immune-signaling mechanism or assay if the interaction is functionally tested.

lensReasons.main: CD33은 시알산 의존적으로 CD45와 결합해 그 인산분해효소 활성을 억제하며, 이 상호작용은 미세아교세포의 아밀로이드 제거 저하와 알츠하이머병 병리에 연결된다.
lensReasons.computational: 미세아교세포-신경세포 공배양에서 아밀로이드 제거와 수상돌기 가시를 분석하고, 유전자형별 단핵구 결합 측정 및 뇌 조직의 발현 연관 분석을 수행했다.

papers.title: 3'UTR-mediated mRNA heterodimerization eventspre-organize protein interactions to drive Wnt gene activation
papers.abstract: Stem cell differentiation is controlled by transcription factors that are often encoded by mRNAs with highly conserved 3'UTRs. To identify 3'UTRs with the potential to drive differentiation, we partially deleted endogenous 3'UTRs. This altered stem cell differentiation efficiency in 7/10 cases without affecting encoded protein expression in 6/7 cases. For mechanistic investigation of abundance-independent regulatory roles of 3'UTRs, we focused on CTNNB1, an mRNA that encodes the essential Wnt co-activator {beta}-catenin. CTNNB1 3'UTR deletion impairs zebrafish embryogenesis and Wnt gene induction during human stem cell differentiation. Long intermolecular 3'UTR-3'UTR interactions between Wnt transcription factor mRNAs and CTNNB1 enable co-translational co-folding of their corresponding proteins. mRNA heterodimerization pre-allocates a portion of {beta}-catenin molecules to the Wnt pathway and away from E-cadherin binding. This ensures protein co-localization with weaker partners, necessary for rapid and high Wnt gene induction. mRNA dimers exist before Wnt activation, indicating that they pre-organize future protein interactions.
papers.shortSummary: CTNNB1 mRNA와 Wnt 전사인자 mRNA의 장거리 3′UTR 상호작용은 Wnt 활성화 전부터 존재하며, 공동 번역되는 단백질의 상호작용을 미리 조직해 β-catenin을 Wnt 경로에 배분한다는 것이 중심 주장입니다.
papers.whyCare: mRNA가 단백질 생성의 주형을 넘어 번역될 단백질의 상호작용을 사전 조직할 수 있다는 주장은, 조절서열의 기능 해석을 발현량 중심에서 RNA 간 상호작용과 단백질 파트너 선택까지 확장합니다.
papers.skepticism: 초록은 결합·공동 번역 접힘·파트너 배분을 기전으로 제시하지만, 어떤 대조군과 직접 측정으로 각 단계를 분리했는지는 밝히지 않습니다. 3′UTR 삭제가 RNA 안정성·위치·번역에도 영향을 주는지, 짝짓기만을 깨뜨리는 교란과 보상 복구가 인과성을 보이는지 확인해야 합니다.

lensReasons.main: 내인성 3′UTR 결실 실험으로 CTNNB1 3′UTR가 전사인자 mRNA와 이합체를 이루어 β-catenin을 Wnt 파트너에 미리 배치하고 Wnt 유전자 활성화를 높이는 역할을 제시한다.
lensReasons.computational: 제브라피시 배아와 인간 줄기세포 분화에서 CTNNB1 3′UTR 결실 효과를 조사해 mRNA 이합체 형성과 β-catenin의 단백질 결합 상대 배분을 연결했다.

papers.title: A quantitative deep-learning-based framework reveals a continuum of chromatin sensitivities across transcription factors
papers.abstract: The genome-wide binding patterns of many transcription factors (TFs) depend not only on the presence of their recognition motifs, but also on the surrounding chromatin context. This raises the question of how binding specificity, which is essential for the proper activation of regulatory regions during development and differentiation, is achieved. Two competing hypotheses have been proposed: either opening is a hierarchical process, whereby chromatin-insensitive TFs bind initially and render the DNA accessible for the subsequent binding of other TFs, or multiple chromatin-sensitive TFs bind cooperatively, enabling them to overcome the chromatin barrier. Here, we provide a quantitative framework to assess the chromatin sensitivity of individual TFs, and demonstrate that it generally depends on motif strength and is a continuum across TFs. This indicates that regulatory regions are activated by neither a purely hierarchical nor a purely cooperative mechanism, but rather by a mixture of both mechanisms, in a locus-specific manner.
papers.whyCare: Quantitative framework linking transcription-factor activity to chromatin context may yield reusable principles for chromatin regulation and computational analysis.
papers.skepticism: Could inform how chromatin accessibility shapes programmable DNA-binding and transcriptional perturbation outcomes.

lensReasons.main: 전사인자의 크로마틴 민감성이 모티프 강도에 따라 연속적으로 달라지며, 유전자 조절 영역은 위치별로 계층적 결합과 협동 결합을 함께 이용함을 제시했습니다.
lensReasons.computational: 전사인자별 크로마틴 민감도를 정량화하는 딥러닝 기반 프레임워크를 제시해 모티프 강도와 결합 맥락을 비교했습니다.

papers.title: Trajectory fit alone does not identify causal edges: a white-box masked ODE benchmark for trans-omics digital twins of drug action mechanisms
papers.abstract: Dynamic multi-omics models infer drug mechanisms from trajectories, but trajectory accuracy alone cannot verify that learned regulatory edges are mechanistically correct. We asked to what extent fitting time-series dynamics identifies intervenable causal edges across observation and optimization budgets.We built white-box ordinary differential equations with candidate-edge masks for gene-expression, protein, signalling and metabolite dynamics, using a mouse-liver trans-omics topology and ground-truth semi-synthetic time series. Under noise-free,complete, densely sampled data, from-scratch training ranked edges near chance(edge-class area under the receiver-operating characteristic curve, 0.48-0.53); the unattainable oracle-initialized upper bound reached 0.94-0.99 on the same metric.Unobserved layers absorbed error. In ground-truth knockout tests, development-batch endpoint-sign accuracy was 67.9% for one-hop non-convergent targets but 33.3% for two-hop targets. Across tested practical budgets, fitting did not yield reliable edge recovery; trajectory fit alone therefore does not establish mechanistic identification. This benchmark supports mechanistic audits and exploratory per-prediction confidence grading in multi-omics models.
papers.shortSummary: 시계열 궤적 적합만으로는 개입 가능한 인과 조절 엣지를 신뢰성 있게 식별할 수 없으며, 좋은 동역학 예측을 기전 검증으로 간주해서는 안 된다는 주장이다.
papers.whyCare: Perturb-seq나 다중오믹스 약물 반응에서 모델 적합도가 높다는 이유만으로 조절 기전을 확정하는 해석을 경계하게 한다. 실험 설계나 편집기 성능을 직접 바꾸는 논문은 아니지만, 기전 후보의 신뢰도 표기와 후속 perturbation 검증을 워크플로에 넣을 근거가 된다.
papers.skepticism: 근거는 마우스 간 전사체 위상에 기반한 백색상자 ODE와 반합성 시계열에 한정된다. 실제 생물학적 네트워크의 복잡성이나 다른 모델 계열에 그대로 일반화되는지는 이 초록만으로 판단할 수 없다. 오라클 초기화 상한은 학습 가능성을 보여주는 성능 기준이 아니라 비교용 상한이며, 1-hop/2-hop 결과는 개발 배치에서의 끝점 부호 예측이다.

lensReasons.main: 다층 오믹스 동역학을 잘 맞추는 것만으로는 약물 작용의 인과 조절선을 복원하기 어렵다는 점을, 마우스 간 전사체·단백질·신호·대사체 구조를 반영한 모형에서 보였다.
lensReasons.computational: 연구진은 후보 인과 연결을 마스킹한 white-box ODE와 반합성 시계열로 학습 예산을 비교했으며, 무잡음·완전 관측 조건에서도 처음부터 학습한 연결 순위는 AUROC 0.48~0.53에 머물렀다.

papers.title: A renewable autologous biomaterial for reprogramming cellular metabolism
papers.abstract: Autologous blood-derived products are attractive for tissue repair because they are biocompatible, renewable and readily accessible, but their liquid form limits local retention and provides little structural support. Here we show that autologous serum can be transformed into an injectable hydrogel microsphere biomaterial using gas-shearing microfluidics combined with ionic and fibrin-based enzymatic crosslinking. Reconstruction of the fibrin network improves structural support, interfacial lubrication and local retention of serum-derived factors. Compared with citrate-anticoagulated PRP, anticoagulant-free autologous serum better preserves chondrocyte metabolic adaptation under hypoxic inflammatory conditions. Multi-omics analyses further indicate enhanced chondrocyte proliferation, migration and matrix maintenance, together with modulation of hypoxia-responsive metabolic pathways. In osteoarthritis models, the microspheres promote cartilage repair and reduce disease progression. These findings establish a renewable autologous serum biomaterial platform that integrates biochemical and mechanical functions and may support personalized regenerative therapies.
papers.whyCare: Biomaterial-driven metabolic reprogramming may contain cell-engineering or metabolic-control principles, but the title gives little indication of the mechanism or applicability.
papers.skepticism: Could provide a strategy for manipulating cellular metabolic state through engineered biomaterials.

lensReasons.main: 자가 혈청을 주사형 미세구 하이드로겔로 만들어 연골 대사와 골관절염 모델의 회복을 개선했다. 재생의학 성과는 있으나 편집기 전달 플랫폼은 아니다.
lensReasons.computational: 멀티오믹스는 대사·세포 반응 분석에 사용되었고 계산 방법론이 주된 기여는 아니다.

papers.title: Lateral interactions between antiparallel filaments drive self-assembly of the FtsZ ring in bacterial cell division
papers.abstract: The Z-ring is the organiser of cell division in most archaea and bacteria, arriving early at mid-cell and recruiting downstream proteins. While FtsZ protofilaments and their treadmilling dynamics are well understood, how FtsZ assembles into condensed Z-rings remains unknown. Here we determined the Escherichia coli in-cell electron cryotomography (cryo-ET) structure of FtsZ to 6.9 [A] resolution, showing antiparallel double filaments with the C-terminus facing the membrane. Electron cryomicroscopy (cryo-EM) of purified E. coli FtsZ showed these double filaments self-assemble. Cryo-ET of cells showed ordering of FtsZ doublets into bands, which we revealed is regulated by the disordered N-terminal residues. Structures of purified Bacillus subtilis and Thermotoga maritima FtsZ demonstrated that antiparallel lateral interactions are a conserved feature. We describe how self-assembly of the Z-ring occurs through two types of lateral interactions and propose a new role for FtsZ treadmilling in reorganising antiparallel lateral interactions during cell constriction.
papers.shortSummary: FtsZ Z-ring은 항평행 이중 필라멘트 사이의 두 유형의 측면 상호작용으로 자가조립하며, treadmilling은 세포 수축 중 이 상호작용의 재배열에 기여한다.
papers.whyCare: FtsZ 필라멘트의 treadmilling만으로는 설명되지 않던 Z-ring의 응축을 항평행 필라멘트 간 측면 상호작용으로 설명한다. 해당 분야의 조립 기전 해석을 바꿀 수 있는 주장이나, 현재 랩의 편집기 엔지니어링 루프와의 직접 연결은 약하다.
papers.skepticism: E. coli 세포 내 구조의 6.9 Å 해상도에서 대안적 필라멘트 배열을 얼마나 배제했는지, N-말단 효과가 어떤 대조군으로 분리됐는지 확인해야 한다. 수축 중 treadmilling이 상호작용을 재배열한다는 설명은 초록에서 제안으로 제시되므로, 직접 관찰된 결과와 기전적 추론을 구분할 필요가 있다.

lensReasons.main: 여러 세균의 FtsZ 구조에서 역평행 이중 필라멘트의 측면 상호작용이 Z-ring을 조립하며, treadmilling이 수축 중 필라멘트 배열을 재구성한다는 모형을 제시한다.
lensReasons.computational: 대장균 세포의 cryo-ET와 정제 FtsZ의 cryo-EM 구조를 분석하고 Bacillus subtilis 및 Thermotoga maritima 구조와 비교해 보존된 역평행 상호작용을 밝혔다.

papers.title: Choline kinase α promotes glycolysis and tumor growth by phosphorylating and activating enolase 1
papers.abstract: Tumor cells exhibit aberrantly upregulated glycolysis, in which glycolytic enzyme enolase 1 (ENO1) plays a critical role. However, how ENO1 activity is dynamically regulated in tumor cells remains elusive. Here, we demonstrate that hypoxic stimulation promotes the binding of p38 MAP kinase to choline kinase α (CHKα). p38 phosphorylates CHKα at S114, subsequently leading to CHKα to interact with ENO1. Importantly, CHKα functions as a protein kinase and phosphorylates ENO1 Y44 thereby enhancing the metabolic activity of ENO1 to increase glycolysis. Knock-in expression of CHKα S114A or ENO1 Y44F inhibits brain tumor cell glycolysis and proliferation, blunts brain tumor growth in mice with inhibited lactate production, and prolongs mouse survival. In addition, CHKα S114 and ENO1 Y44 phosphorylation levels are positively correlated with each other and associated with poor prognosis in glioblastoma patients. These findings highlight the critical regulation of glycolysis by the noncanonical function of CHKα and underscore the potential to target the moonlighting function of CHKα for cancer treatment.
papers.whyCare: A causal cancer-metabolism mechanism, but its connection to organelle biology or the lab's engineering directions is uncertain.
papers.skepticism: Could be of interest if it reports reusable metabolic perturbation assays or links glycolytic state to mitochondrial function.

lensReasons.main: CHKα의 비정형 키나아제 기능이 ENO1을 활성화해 해당과정과 뇌종양 성장을 촉진한다. 변이 knock-in과 생쥐 생존 결과가 뒷받침되지만 연구실의 핵심 엔지니어링 축과는 거리가 있다.
lensReasons.computational: 계산 분석이 논문의 주요 방법 또는 독립 기여로 제시되지 않는다.

papers.title: Atomic-resolution insights into interactions of rifampicin and rifamycin derivatives with orphan CYP143 of M. tuberculosis
papers.abstract: Analysis of drug-resistant strains of M. tuberculosis identified a Gly334Ala mutation in the orphan CYP143 gene, located within the ESX-5 secretion cluster. Guided by this clinical association, we tested the frontline antitubercular agent rifampicin as a CYP143 ligand. Atomic-resolution structures reveal a closed binding mode of rifampicin above the heme, which we also observed for other natural and synthetic rifamycins. The high quality of crystallographic data for both the wild type and mutant structures allowed us to track ligand-induced changes from the active site to the meander, the binding site for the redox partner. Consistent with this, the structure of a CYP143–ligand–redox partner complex confirms that these conformational changes are directly coupled to ligand binding. The structure of CYP143 with a selective inhibitor provides a template for rational drug design. Together, these results advance the understanding of rifampicin resistance/tolerance and the role of the orphan CYPome of M. tuberculosis .
papers.whyCare: Atomic-resolution ligand-binding work could offer structural or biochemical insights, but it concerns a pathogen enzyme rather than a lab-relevant target.
papers.skepticism: Abstract may reveal reusable structure-function or ligand-interaction principles relevant to protein engineering.

lensReasons.main: 원자 수준 구조와 복합체 분석으로 리팜피신 결합이 CYP143의 활성부위에서 redox-partner 결합 부위까지 구조 변화를 전달함을 보여준다. 구조적 근거는 강하지만 연구실 우선 분야와의 실용적 연결은 제한적이다.
lensReasons.computational: 구조 해석이 핵심이며, 별도의 계산 방법 개발이 주된 기여는 아니다.

papers.title: Environmental toxicant-induced epigenetic and transcriptional reprogramming of transposable elements
papers.abstract: Transposable elements (TEs) are mobile DNA sequences that constitute a significant portion of mammalian genomes and are generally epigenetically silenced, yet can regulate gene expression and chromatin architecture. Their roles under environmental exposure remain unclear. Here, we integrated 351 multi-omic datasets from adult mouse liver following early-life exposure to arsenic, lead, bisphenol A, tributyltin, di-2-ethylhexyl phthalate, tetrachlorodibenzo-p-dioxin, and particulate matter less than 2.5 micrometers. Early-life toxicant exposure altered chromatin accessibility and expression of TEs in later life, revealing exposure-specific and sex-dependent responses. Most differentially accessible TEs located in non-coding regions. Genes associated with Long Interspersed Nuclear Elements (LINEs) were enriched in metabolic pathways, while long terminal repeat elements, particularly the ORR1E subfamily, were associated with immune-related genes. We also identified 164 TE-gene chimeric transcripts with TE-derived transcription start sites, highlighting TE-contributed transcriptional plasticity. Our findings depict a landscape of TE response to early-life toxicant exposures in mouse liver.
papers.whyCare: Potentially informative epigenetic mechanism linking environmental exposure to transposable-element regulation; title does not establish a reusable mechanism or method.
papers.skepticism: Could inform discussion of chromatin regulation and transcriptional consequences of epigenetic perturbation.

lensReasons.main: 생애 초기 환경 독성물질 노출이 성체 생쥐 간의 전이인자 접근성과 발현을 성별·노출물질별로 바꾸고 유전자 조절과 연결됨을 보였습니다.
lensReasons.computational: 351개 다중오믹스 데이터셋을 통합해 전이인자 변화와 유전자 연관성을 분석하고, 전이인자 유래 전사 시작점을 가진 키메라 전사체 164개를 확인했습니다.

papers.title: CARM1-mediated methylation controls interactions of ALIX with key partners important for cytokinesis
papers.abstract: CARM1 is an arginine methyltransferase with a well-established role in regulating gene expression, but its cytoplasmic functions remain largely uncharacterized. Here, we identified ALIX, a cytoplasmic protein acting with the ESCRT-III machinery in numerous membrane remodeling events, as a partner and substrate of CARM1. We demonstrate that CARM1 methylates arginine residues within the proline-rich motif of ALIX. At the molecular level, ALIX methylation impairs SH3-dependent association with CD2AP, CIN85, and endophilin-A2 that are required for cytokinesis. Using a mutant of ALIX that is unable to bind these proteins, we further show that these interactions are essential for ALIX functions during cytokinesis. Mechanistically, ALIX methylation controls the levels of CD2AP at the cytokinetic midbody, which are known to be critical for successful cytokinesis. Altogether, this work highlights the significance of arginine methylation as a regulatory post-translational modification important for the final step of cell division, by modulating interactions between proline-rich domains and their SH3-containing partners.
papers.whyCare: A specific post-translational modification mechanism regulating cytokinesis, with potential relevance to broad cell biology and epigenetic regulation.
papers.skepticism: Could provide a mechanistic example of how methylation rewires protein interactions and cell-division outcomes.

lensReasons.main: CARM1의 ALIX 아르기닌 메틸화는 CD2AP·CIN85·endophilin-A2 결합을 약화해 세포질분열 중간체의 CD2AP 수준과 세포분열 마지막 단계를 조절한다.

papers.title: [c2]Daisy-chain molecular turing machines with switchable fluorescence outputs
papers.abstract: Synthetic small-molecule machines capable of bidirectionally reading and writing information on molecular tapes with visual output remain elusive due to the challenge in amplifying molecular-scale motions into macroscopic signals. Herein, we report two [c2]daisy-chain molecular Turing machines that convert reversible mechanical motions into different fluorescence signals by developing novel aggregation-induced emission luminogens with an intramolecular charge transfer mechanism. Attributed to the collective and amplified shuttling motions triggered by anions or solvents, the [c2]daisy chains exhibit controllable and reversible fluorescence modulation in solution for up to 42 cycles. Moreover, incorporation of [c2]daisy chains into polymers yields fast-response macroscopic Turing machines capable of conformation-dependent fluorescence switching. Importantly, the [c2]daisy chains enable binary ASCII and nucleotide-base encoding, allowing visual representation of letters, digits, and 64 genetic codons. By mapping codons to fluorescence, they also enable visual decoding of DNA information, bridging molecular-scale motion to macroscopically readable information processing and advancing functional molecular computation.
papers.whyCare: Programmable molecular computation and switchable outputs could offer synthetic-biology concepts, but the title does not establish a biological application.
papers.skepticism: Potentially useful design logic for programmable molecular systems or signal readouts.

papers.title: A long-read based haplotype panel enhances imputation and discovery of functional small and structural variants
papers.abstract: Haplotype reference panels are commonly used for genotype imputation in genome-wide association studies (GWAS). Although structural variants (SVs) are recognized as major contributors to human phenotypes, they are often excluded from GWAS analyses. Here, we integrate long-read-based and statistical methods to provide a comprehensive haplotype reference panel (Han-SV panel) incorporating 32,603,300 single nucleotide variants, 3,180,227 small deletions and insertions and 172,569 SVs derived from 943 Han Chinese individuals. Our hybrid phasing approach had a 2 to 5-fold reduction in phasing error for small variants and 2 to 9-fold for SVs compared to conventional statistical phasing. This Han-SV panel enabled a more than two-fold in amount and 9-22% in accuracy improvement of SV imputation compared to the expanded 1000 Genomes Project panel. Two GWASs using our panel-imputed variants identified 69 associated SVs and 101 previously unreported regions associated with skin-related and fingerprint phenotypes—substantially outperforming both short-read and array-based GWAS. This Han-SV panel offers a valuable resource for variant imputation and SV-included association studies to further uncover the novel phenotype associations and address critical gaps in missing heritability. An imputation server was provided for the use of the Han-SV panel ( https://www.biosino.org/svrp ).
papers.whyCare: A genomic resource and variant-discovery method, potentially useful for interpreting functional variation but not directly an editing or editor-engineering advance.
papers.skepticism: Could provide useful variant datasets or methodological ideas for genome-wide design and validation workflows.

papers.title: var2csa transcription implicates variant surface antigen switching in cerebral malaria pathogenesis
papers.abstract: Previous PCR-based gene expression studies linked severe malaria, including cerebral malaria (CM), to Plasmodium falciparum erythrocyte membrane protein-1 (PfEMP1) variants that bind endothelial protein C receptor (EPCR). Using RNA sequencing and de novo transcriptome assembly in a matched CM case-control study of Malian children, we quantify var gene transcripts encoding PfEMP1s in 13 matched pairs of CM cases and uncomplicated malaria controls and in 25 CM cases and 55 uncomplicated malaria controls. Contrary to earlier findings, PfEMP1s that bind EPCR alone are not associated with CM. Transcription of conserved gene var2csa is implicated in var gene switching in vitro. Here, its transcription is significantly associated with CM across study sites, suggesting that switching may contribute to CM pathogenesis. Importantly, this association is observed at the transcript level, but potentially not translation. We use a protein microarray to show a lack of antibody responses to the VAR2CSA antigen in cerebral malaria, supporting an association between CM and var2csa transcription rather than antigenic presence. CM is also associated with distinct var transcriptional profiles and dual ICAM-1/EPCR-binding PfEMP1 variants. These findings underscore the complexity of PfEMP1-mediated pathogenesis and highlight the need for deeper investigation of transcriptional and regulatory mechanisms underlying severe malaria.
papers.whyCare: The title suggests a transcriptional mechanism in parasite antigen switching, but its broader epigenetic or mechanistic relevance is uncertain.
papers.skepticism: Abstract may reveal reusable principles of transcriptional regulation or antigen-switching control.

papers.title: Lithium coordination compound reduces nephrotoxicity and enhances therapeutic effects in Alzheimer’s disease female mice
papers.abstract: Lithium holds therapeutic promise for Alzheimer’s disease (AD), yet its clinical application is hindered by a narrow therapeutic range and nephrotoxicity. We rationally design a lithium coordination compound, BuLiPro, chelated with endogenous butyrate and proline. Single-crystal diffraction and mass-spectrometry confirm its crystal structure and solution-state coordination, while spectroscopic assays verify an identity distinct from free lithium. Compared with lithium carbonate, BuLiPro achieves improved plasma exposure, slower clearance, and 61.6%-higher brain lithium accumulation at 48 h in rats. It yields lower renal cytotoxicity and in vivo kidney injury, and inhibits glycogen synthase kinase-3β over three-fold more potently. In female AD model mice, BuLiPro attenuates tau and amyloid-β pathologies to a greater extent and rescues cognition. This coordination-based strategy enhances lithium’s central bioavailability and reduces systemic toxicity, offering a framework for the development of next-generation lithium therapeutics.
papers.whyCare: An in vivo therapeutic intervention in a CNS disease model may have relevant assays or mechanistic findings, but the title suggests primarily therapeutic evaluation.
papers.skepticism: Abstract may reveal a reusable neurodegeneration or toxicity mechanism, or mitochondrial/organelle readouts.

papers.title: Curated annotations locate biological concepts in protein language models from layers to neurons
papers.abstract: Interpretability methods describe what a network has learned, yet their claims are rarely tested against model-independent ground truth. We argue that proteins are an ideal modality for interpretability since curators annotate functional sites residue by residue. Across three ESMC protein language models (300M-6B parameters), we show that conclusions depend on where models are read, how concepts are decoded, which units are examined, and how they are scored. Concepts become linearly readable along depth long before erasure impairs masked-token prediction, and 20-fold scaling shifts concept depth more than peak score. Most of a nonlinear probe's lead over a linear one reflects fitting and readout shape rather than nonlinear encoding. Over whole proteins, saturated metrics render feed-forward neurons indistinguishable from random rotations. At annotated residues, dual-signed neuron poles identify 2.5-5.4 times as many concepts as rotations without training, though sparse autoencoders identify more. Without held-out validation, however, shuffled annotations label nearly every latent, and causal reliance emerges in neuron groups rather than single poles. Reading selected intra-block states exposes binding and active sites that stream probes read poorly and lifts a simple probe 5% above the best published MCC on a leakage-controlled interaction benchmark. We recommend reading a model directly against annotation, scoring units where they fire with a measure that is not saturated, and training a dictionary only where it adds coverage.
papers.shortSummary: 단백질 LM에서 기능 개념을 읽는 결과는 분석 층과 내부 상태, 개념 디코딩 방식, 단위 선택 및 점수화 방식에 민감하며, 잔기별 annotation을 기준으로 각 선택을 검증해야 한다는 주장입니다.
papers.whyCare: 단백질 LM의 해석 결과를 모델 독립적인 잔기별 annotation으로 검증하고, 포화된 단백질 단위 지표나 부적절한 상태 선택이 결론을 왜곡할 수 있음을 보여줍니다. 모델 해석을 engineering loop에 넣기 전에 어떤 readout을 신뢰할지 정하는 데 유용한 방법론적 경고입니다.

papers.title: Iso-Seq enables discovery of novel isoform variants in human retina at single-cell resolution
papers.abstract: Single cell transcriptomic profiling of the retina provided important insights into the genetic signals in retinal cells that enable vision. However, conventional 3’ short-read sequencing method is not suitable to identify isoform variants. Here we utilized Iso-Seq with full-length sequencing to profile the human retina at single cell resolution for isoform discovery. We generated a retina transcriptome dataset consisting of 23,523 nuclei from three donor retina, and identified 15,967 known isoforms and 7,617 novel isoforms across 10 major cell types. We showed that up to 2.6% of genes utilized multiple promoters across major retinal cell types. Also, our results identified novel transcript variants for inherited retinal disease (IRD) genes and differential usage of exon splicing in major retinal cell types. Altogether, this study reported a detailed Human Retina Gene Atlas to study isoform diversity at single cell resolution, providing an expanded view of the complex transcriptomic landscape in the retina.
papers.whyCare: A single-cell isoform method or dataset could be useful, though the title suggests a tissue-specific discovery resource rather than a broadly enabling screen.
papers.skepticism: Could inform single-cell transcriptomic assay design or analysis if the method generalizes beyond retina.

papers.title: VHSeek: biology foundation model-based virus representations revealing virus host associations
papers.abstract: Virus-host association prediction is fundamental to virus-related disease control and phage therapy, yet many existing tools require candidate-host genome sequences, which may be unavailable for some eukaryotic hosts or impractical to search at the scale of large virome studies. We present VHSeek, a supervised virus-host association predictor that integrates DNA- and protein-derived viral representations. VHSeek combines nucleotide representations from AIDO.DNA and protein representations from ESM2 to learn virus-host association patterns, and then transfers predictions through known host taxonomies from lower to higher ranks. During inference, VHSeek uses viral sequence data and known host taxonomies, without host sequence data. Compared with iPHoP, the state-of-the-art baseline evaluated in this study, VHSeek improves genus-level maximum F1 score (Fmax), Top-1 accuracy, and area under the precision–recall curve (AUPR) by 12%, 19%, and 27%, respectively. Confidence thresholding enables abstention and reduces false discoveries. On the processed IMG/VR v4.1 metagenomic collection, VHSeek expands effective host coverage from 36.5% to 64.5% using a validation-calibrated confidence threshold. VHSeek prioritizes candidate viruses and reservoir hosts with potential human health impacts, including multi-host hypotheses in which one virus may be associated with humans and additional hosts (e.g., Saboya virus with Homo sapiens and Culicidae) not currently captured in the dataset.
papers.whyCare: A task-specific biology foundation model and virus-representation method may be worth checking for reusable computational design or evaluation ideas.
papers.skepticism: Potentially relevant to AI-guided biological sequence modeling, though the virus-host prediction task is distant from the lab’s core work.

papers.title: Tomato NLR R1L mediates SlSPL3 degradation to trigger a growth-to-defense switch against Phytophthora infestans
papers.abstract: Intracellular nucleotide-binding leucine-rich repeat (NLR) receptors activate effector-triggered immunity (ETI), a key branch of plant immunity conferring robust resistance. The downstream signaling mechanisms of ETI receptors remain unclear. We characterize tomato NLR protein R1L that specifically recognizes the Phytophthora infestans effector AVR1. R1L is predominantly cytoplasmic and partially relocalizes into the nucleus upon infection. With helper SlNRC1, R1L and AVR1 trigger a hypersensitive response (HR). R1L positively regulates tomato immunity against P. infestans . Yeast two-hybrid screening identified SlSPL3, a positive regulator of growth and development, as a direct R1L interactor. SlSPL3 binds the GTAC-box motif in the SlLTP3 promoter and activates this negative immune regulator. R1L counteracts SlSPL3-mediated immune suppression by promoting the ubiquitin-mediated degradation of SlSPL3. Thus, the AVR1-R1L-SlSPL3-SlLTP3 module mediates a growth-immunity trade-off. In uninfected plants, SlSPL3 promotes growth and suppresses immunity via SlLTP3. Upon infection, R1L-mediated SlSPL3 degradation activates immunity and represses growth. This study elucidates a pathogen perception-transcriptional reprogramming-immunity axis, offering insights into plant defense and growth-immunity balance.
papers.whyCare: A causal protein-degradation mechanism governing a growth-defense switch is biologically substantive, though in a plant-pathogen context outside the lab's core systems.
papers.skepticism: Could provide a useful example of regulated protein turnover and trade-offs between growth and stress defense.

papers.title: Dissecting the root-fungal interface in 3D reveals spatially distinct signalling landscapes
papers.abstract: Plant-fungal interactions in the rhizosphere influence plant health. Current understanding of these processes largely derives from in vitro flat plates, hydroponics and gnotobiotic platforms. However, fungal-plant interactions largely occur in soil – a disordered and granular 3D environment with heterogeneous elasto-viscoplastic properties – whose inherent opacity precludes direct visualisation of the infection. How the physical structure of such natural habitats influences interkingdom interactions remains unknown. Here, we introduce an optically transparent 3D jammed granular microgel matrix that mimics the mechanical properties of natural microenvironments. This platform supports long-term co-culture of plants and fungi, while being compatible with classical physiological assays. We accomplish a direct cellular-level visualisation of the plant-fungal interface. Specifically, host-derived signals prior to the physical contact trigger hyphal reorientation towards the root tips. Using spatiotemporally resolved transcriptomics we discover distinct pathogen-host ex- and in-planta signalling modules, which are associated with granular heterogeneous environments. Together, our findings establish an experimental platform for dissecting fungal development and pathogenesis with unprecedented microscopic and molecular resolution.
papers.whyCare: A spatially resolved biological interface study; possible methodological or signaling insights, though the system is outside the lab's main interests.
papers.skepticism: The 3D spatial analysis may offer transferable approaches for studying organoid or cellular signaling environments.
